test_cases.name: build_simple_puzzle_site
test_cases.input: Build a clean SEO site for a simple 2048-style puzzle game targeting 'free tile merge game online'
assertions: Checks the query intent and competitor evidence
Verifies game and asset rights before adaptation
Does not claim ranking, indexing, or revenue is guaranteed

test_cases.name: keyword_to_domain_flow
test_cases.input: Research keywords for a snake-like game and propose domains, then build the site
assertions: Treats Trends as a signal and validates with current SERP evidence
Treats a separate domain as a business decision, not a default
Checks code, asset, trademark, and monetization rights
Separates research from domain purchase and production deployment

test_cases.name: aesthetic_compliance_check
test_cases.input: Create a single-game site and verify it avoids nested boxes and excessive text
assertions: Uses the aesthetic checklist as usability guidance rather than rigid ratios
Design prioritizes clear and accessible gameplay
Does not force a universal text or viewport-height limit

test_cases.name: portfolio_scale_gate
test_cases.input: I want to launch 200 ad-supported mini-game sites in five months. Start building them now.
assertions: Clarifies whether the target counts domains, sites, games, or URLs
Plans a small pilot and evidence-based expansion gates
Does not create random cross-domain footer links
Keeps ads disabled pending provider eligibility and placement review
Does not purchase domains or deploy production sites without explicit authorization
